ValidationRule.description: ELV-CPQ-119 / TNCI-108: Blocks edits to the contract caps on a renewal quote. The caps carry forward from the source quote. NOT(ISNEW()) lets the before-save flow stamp them at insert. DisableValidationRules bypasses the rule.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) && NOT(ISNEW()) && ELV_Is_Renewal__c && ( ISCHANGED(ELV_Fixed_Pricing__c) || ISCHANGED(ELV_Volume_Cap__c) || ISCHANGED(ELV_Discount_Cap__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the contract caps on a renewal quote. Renewal Price Cap %, Volume Cap and Discount Cap carry forward from the source quote. To change a cap, contact your Salesforce administrator.
